items.title: US Hackers Face $1,000 Monthly Pay Cut in Controversial Plan
items.content: US soldiers tasked with hacking American adversaries and defending the nation’s computers are set to see their incentive pay cut by as much as $12,000 a year as part of an overhaul that’s drawn ire from the ranks, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg and people familiar with the situation.
items.contentSnippet: US soldiers tasked with hacking American adversaries and defending the nation’s computers are set to see their incentive pay cut by as much as $12,000 a year as part of an overhaul that’s drawn ire from the ranks, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg and people familiar with the situation.
items.creator: Patrick Howell O'Neill and Jake Bleiberg

summaries.zh: 据彭博社及知情人士透露，美国负责网络攻防的军人将面临一项改革计划，其月度奖金可能削减高达1200美元，年减约1.2万美元。此举引发部队不满，但具体细节未公开。
summaries.en: US hackers face a controversial plan to cut their incentive pay by up to $12,000 annually, reducing their monthly earnings to around $1,000. The move, part of a broader overhaul, has drawn criticism from military personnel. The changes, detailed in documents reviewed by Bloomberg and confirmed by informed sources, aim to streamline operations but have sparked backlash within the ranks.

items.title: OpenAI Employee Quits With Call for Nuclear-Level Safeguards
items.content: An OpenAI employee focused on AI safety has quit the company and warned that top artificial intelligence firms aren’t doing enough to mitigate the technology’s risks, joining a growing chorus of employees raising alarms from within the industry.
items.contentSnippet: An OpenAI employee focused on AI safety has quit the company and warned that top artificial intelligence firms aren’t doing enough to mitigate the technology’s risks, joining a growing chorus of employees raising alarms from within the industry.
items.creator: Seth Fiegerman

summaries.zh: 一位专注于AI安全的OpenAI员工已离职，呼吁对人工智能技术采取核级别的安全保障措施。该员工警告，顶尖AI公司尚未充分应对技术风险，此举是业内日益增多的员工内部警示声浪之一。
summaries.en: An OpenAI employee specializing in AI safety has resigned, urging stronger "nuclear-level" safeguards for artificial intelligence due to insufficient risk mitigation efforts by leading firms. This follows other industry insiders raising concerns about the technology's potential dangers.

items.title: War, Cyber Attack May Spark Next Financial Crisis, RBI Says
items.content: The next financial crisis could originate from a source outside the world of finance, Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said Saturday.
items.contentSnippet: The next financial crisis could originate from a source outside the world of finance, Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said Saturday.
items.creator: Anup Roy, Siddhartha Singh and Saikat Das

summaries.zh: 印度储备银行行长Sanjay Malhotra表示，下一次金融危机可能源自金融领域之外。他认为，战争和网络攻击可能是引发危机的潜在因素。
summaries.en: The Reserve Bank of India's Governor Sanjay Malhotra warned that the next financial crisis may stem from non-financial sources, such as war or cyber attacks.

items.title: Taiwan Foreign Minister to Visit Arizona to Deepen Economic Ties
items.content: Taiwan’s foreign minister is set to visit Arizona for meetings with local officials and semiconductor companies, underscoring Taipei’s effort to deepen economic ties with the US as President Donald Trump seeks to stabilize relations with China.

items.title: NYU's Gary Marcus on AI development concerns
items.content: Gary Marcus, Robust AI Inc. co-founder and former CEO, argues that developers, including OpenAI, lack sufficient safeguards for systems they can't reliably control. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Gary Marcus, Robust AI Inc. co-founder and former CEO, argues that developers, including OpenAI, lack sufficient safeguards for systems they can't reliably control. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 纽约大学学者Gary Marcus在彭博节目《The Close》中，作为Robust AI公司联合创始人和前CEO，指出OpenAI等AI开发者缺乏足够的安全措施，无法可靠控制其系统。他认为当前AI发展存在风险。
summaries.en: Gary Marcus, co-founder and former CEO of Robust AI Inc., expresses concerns about AI development, arguing that companies like OpenAI lack sufficient safeguards for systems they cannot reliably control. He discusses these issues in an interview with Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's "The Close." (90 words)

items.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T Glitch Requires Device Replacements
items.content: Apple Inc. said “a small number” of AT&T Inc. customers who recently upgraded to the company’s iPhone 18 Pro Max will need to replace their devices after a bug caused them to lose cellular service.
items.contentSnippet: Apple Inc. said “a small number” of AT&T Inc. customers who recently upgraded to the company’s iPhone 18 Pro Max will need to replace their devices after a bug caused them to lose cellular service.
items.creator: Chris Welch

summaries.zh: 苹果公司表示，少数近期升级至iPhone 18 Pro Max的AT&T用户因系统故障导致失去蜂窝服务，需更换设备。此次问题影响范围有限，公司已着手解决。
summaries.en: Apple Inc. reported that a minor glitch affected a small number of AT&T customers who recently upgraded to the iPhone 18 Pro Max, causing cellular service loss. Affected users will need to replace their devices. The issue has been addressed, and replacements are being provided to resolve the problem.

items.title: Apple to Tighten Mac Data Controls in Guard Against AI Agents
items.content: Apple Inc. said it plans to introduce new privacy controls for Mac users, warning of the growing risks around granting broad data access to third-party software, including artificial intelligence agents.
items.contentSnippet: Apple Inc. said it plans to introduce new privacy controls for Mac users, warning of the growing risks around granting broad data access to third-party software, including artificial intelligence agents.
items.creator: Natalie Lung

summaries.zh: 苹果公司计划推出新的Mac隐私控制措施，以应对第三方软件（包括人工智能代理）授予广泛数据访问权限的日益风险。此举旨在加强数据保护，防止敏感信息泄露。
summaries.en: Apple is introducing stricter privacy controls for Mac users to mitigate risks associated with granting broad data access to third-party software, particularly AI agents. The company highlights growing concerns about data security and privacy as AI tools demand more user information. These new measures aim to enhance user protection while using third-party applications.

items.title: Nvidia Falls Short of May Record as Value Nears $6 Trillion
items.content: Nvidia Corp. shares touched an intraday high for the first time since May before trimming those gains and closing just short of a record as investors piled back into the stock after a two-month selloff that wiped out more than $1 trillion of market value.
items.contentSnippet: Nvidia Corp. shares touched an intraday high for the first time since May before trimming those gains and closing just short of a record as investors piled back into the stock after a two-month selloff that wiped out more than $1 trillion of market value.
items.creator: Carmen Reinicke

summaries.zh: 英伟达股价时隔两个月再度创纪录，市值接近6万亿美元。投资者在股价两月下跌、市值蒸发超1万亿美元后重新买入，推动股价上涨。
summaries.en: Nvidia Corp. shares reached a record high for the first time since May, as investors returned to the stock following a two-month decline. The selloff had reduced the company's market value by over $1 trillion.

items.content: Nscale, the artificial intelligence infrastructure company, hired a long-time Meta Platforms Inc. executive to be its chief operating officer, to accelerate a rapid expansion connected to its upcoming initial public offering, according to a person familiar with the matter.

items.title: Colombia Has Started Payments on €3.1 Billion Saab Fighter Deal
items.content: Colombia has begun paying for a €3.1 billion fleet of Saab fighter jets ordered by the previous government, complicating any attempt by President Abelardo de la Espriella to unwind the purchase as he struggles to repair the nation’s finances.
items.contentSnippet: Colombia has begun paying for a €3.1 billion fleet of Saab fighter jets ordered by the previous government, complicating any attempt by President Abelardo de la Espriella to unwind the purchase as he struggles to repair the nation’s finances.
items.creator: Oscar Medina

summaries.zh: 哥伦比亚已开始支付3.1亿欧元萨伯战斗机订单款项，该订单由前任政府下达。此举使总统阿贝尔拉多·德·拉·埃斯皮里亚在试图撤销购买、同时努力改善国家财政状况时面临困难。
summaries.en: Colombia has initiated payments for a €3.1 billion Saab fighter jet deal initially ordered by the previous government. The move complicates President Abelardo de la Espriella's efforts to reverse the purchase as he addresses the country's financial challenges. The deal involves a fleet of Saab fighter jets, and the ongoing payments highlight the difficulty of unwinding the agreement.

items.title: Hackers Breached Propulsion System of US-Bound Oil Tanker
items.content: FBI and US Coast Guard investigators have found evidence that hackers accessed the propulsion system of an oil supertanker as it was approaching the Texas coast this summer, according to US officials familiar with the matter, an extraordinary breach that highlights the growing physical risks from cyberattacks.
items.contentSnippet: FBI and US Coast Guard investigators have found evidence that hackers accessed the propulsion system of an oil supertanker as it was approaching the Texas coast this summer, according to US officials familiar with the matter, an extraordinary breach that highlights the growing physical risks from cyberattacks.
items.creator: Jake Bleiberg and Ruth Liao

summaries.zh: 美国官员透露，FBI和海岸警卫队调查发现，今年夏季一艘驶向德克萨斯州海岸的油轮推进系统遭黑客入侵。此次入侵事件凸显了网络攻击日益严重的物理风险。
summaries.en: Hackers breached the propulsion system of a US-bound oil supertanker near the Texas coast this summer, according to FBI and US Coast Guard investigators. The incident, confirmed by US officials, underscores the escalating physical threats posed by cyberattacks. The findings highlight concerns about the vulnerability of critical maritime infrastructure to digital threats.

items.title: Fed’s Kashkari Says AI Not Only Driver of US Growth
items.content: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari said he was skeptical of the argument that the US economy is shrinking but for a boom in construction related to artificial intelligence.
items.contentSnippet: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari said he was skeptical of the argument that the US economy is shrinking but for a boom in construction related to artificial intelligence.
items.creator: Laura Curtis

summaries.zh: 美联储明尼苏达银行行长尼尔·卡什卡里表示，他对“美国经济仅因人工智能相关建筑业的繁荣而未萎缩”的说法持怀疑态度。他认为，人工智能并非美国经济增长的唯一驱动力。
summaries.en: Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis President Neel Kashkari expressed skepticism about claims that US economic growth is solely driven by AI-related construction. He countered the argument that the economy is shrinking due to this boom, suggesting a more nuanced view of growth drivers.

items.title: Divergent Targets Faster, Cheaper Defense Production
items.content: Divergent CEO Lukas Czinger says advanced manufacturing can help the Pentagon build weapons faster, cheaper and at far greater scale. Working with Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works and other defense contractors, Divergent uses technologies including 3D printing to move from engineering inputs to flight-ready hardware in under three months. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Divergent CEO Lukas Czinger says advanced manufacturing can help the Pentagon build weapons faster, cheaper and at far greater scale. Working with Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works and other defense contractors, Divergent uses technologies including 3D printing to move from engineering inputs to flight-ready hardware in under three months. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Divergent公司CEO卢卡斯·茨inger表示，先进制造技术有助于五角大楼更快、更经济地大规模生产武器。该公司与洛克希德·马丁的“臭鼬工厂”等国防承包商合作，运用3D打印等技术，将工程输入转化为可飞行硬件的时间缩短至三个月以内。此观点在“Bloomberg Tech”节目中提出。（来源：彭博社）
summaries.en: Divergent CEO Lukas Czinger highlights how advanced manufacturing, including 3D printing, enables the Pentagon to produce weapons faster, cheaper, and in larger quantities. Collaborating with Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works and other defense contractors, Divergent can create flight-ready hardware in under three months by transforming engineering inputs directly into physical components. The approach aims to enhance defense production efficiency and scalability. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Lockheed Taps OpenAI to Solve F-35 Challenges
items.content: Lockheed Martin is taking a model-agnostic approach to AI, using 55 different large language models across its business while applying the technology to everything from internal operations to autonomous weapons systems. SVP of Technology and Strategic Innovation Sarah Hiza discusses how Lockheed tests AI before deploying it, the growing role of autonomy and crewed-uncrewed teaming, and reveals that OpenAI is working alongside the F-35 team to tackle complex math and physics challenges tied to advanced sensor capabilities. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Bloomberg Defense Tech Special 10/02/2026
items.content: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow is live from Skunk Works, Lockheed Martin's advanced aircraft development facility in Southern California. Lockheed Martin's OJ Sanchez and Sarah Hiza weigh in on the company’s road to innovation in the defense tech space, Fortem CEO Jon Gruen discusses the drone warfare landscape, and Divergent CEO Lukas Czinger explains how the startup is helping build weapons faster, cheaper and at far greater scale. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Lockheed Backs Fortem’s Counter-Drone Push
items.content: Fortem has raised $50 million in Series B funding, with Lockheed Martin participating as the counter-drone company looks to rapidly expand manufacturing and bookings. CEO Jon Gruen discusses how the partnership with Lockheed has evolved from venture investment to deploying technology together, and lessons learned from operating in active conflict zones. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Fortem has raised $50 million in Series B funding, with Lockheed Martin participating as the counter-drone company looks to rapidly expand manufacturing and bookings. CEO Jon Gruen discusses how the partnership with Lockheed has evolved from venture investment to deploying technology together, and lessons learned from operating in active conflict zones. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 洛克希德·马丁公司参与了Fortem的B轮融资，该公司正通过快速扩张制造和订单来应对无人机威胁。FortemCEO Jon Gruen表示，与洛克希德的合作已从风险投资发展为共同部署技术，并分享了在冲突地区运营的教训。此次融资将支持其反无人机技术的进一步发展。(来源：彭博)
summaries.en: Fortem secured $50 million in Series B funding, with Lockheed Martin as a participant, to expand manufacturing and bookings for its counter-drone solutions. CEO Jon Gruen highlighted the evolving partnership with Lockheed, moving from venture investment to joint technology deployment, and shared insights from conflict zone operations. The company aims to grow rapidly with this support. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Inside Skunk Works: Lockheed’s Bet on Vectis
items.content: From inside Lockheed Martin’s storied Skunk Works, Aeronautics President OJ Sanchez discusses the company’s push to move faster on the next generation of air power. He explains why Lockheed is investing ahead of formal Pentagon requirements in its autonomous Vectis aircraft, and how a single F-35 could eventually control as many as eight Vectis drones. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
